Ask My Docs

Twelve public-domain food-safety sheets, searched sixteen ways. The winner is LLM chunks reranked by Groq. These are US rules.

This page is the saved evaluation. A new question needs the local embedding model, so the ask box stays on your computer.

uv run python app.py

Retrieval comparison

Cited answers kept 7 of 16 in-scope replies. Refusals held on 10 of 10. A judge scored those shipped answers 2.62 for accuracy, 2.50 for completeness, and 2.69 for relevance, out of 5.
